note: Rebuilt from the user's deck-list screenshot on 2026-09-18. Names and powers are read from that list; where a basic repeats, the exact PRINTING was chosen to keep the deck legal and may not match the physical deck. Its Stronghold is the Living Stronghold, which sits outside the 20. Avatar's Burden swapped for the Earth Bolt at the user's request on 2026-09-24 — the deck is named for bolts and held only three of the six, and the Earth Bolt was in no deck at all, so its heave could never be seen in a game.

abilities.name: Attuned
abilities.text: Put an Attachment from your hand onto this fighter (swap instead if it has an Attachment already). Use the Action ability of that Attachment. Do not fatigue this fighter.

abilities.name: Born of Bolt
abilities.text: Deploy this fighter to an unoccupied square adjacent to an Attachment you control. Put that Attachment on this fighter. You may Use its Ability.

abilities.name: Pilot Animal
abilities.text: Once per turn, after this fighter Moves or is relocated, you may relocate target other fighter you control to the square it left. If you do, you may repeat this ability with that fighter.

abilities.name: Double Stitch
abilities.text: After a fighter you control resolves an Action ability, this fighter may also resolve that ability.

abilities.name: Balanced Weave
abilities.text: While this fighter is in your Gates, fighters with an Attachment you control may take Actions while fatigued.

cards.name: Lightning Bolt
cards.text: Attach to a friendly fighter. This fighter gains "(action) Relocate this fighter to an empty square that is 2 or less squares away." Once per turn, after attached Hunter Moves or is relocated, it may Use this Ability.

cards.name: Fire Bolt
cards.text: Attach to a friendly fighter. This fighter gains "(action) Destroy target adjacent I or II that is not in a stack." Once per turn, after attached Soldier Moves or is relocated, it may Use this Ability.

cards.name: Earth Bolt
cards.text: Attach to a friendly fighter. This fighter gains "(action) Relocate target adjacent fighter 1 square without its stack." Once per turn, after attached Brute Moves or is relocated, it may Use this Ability.

cards.name: Fatewoven Tapestry
cards.text: Attach to a friendly fighter. This fighter gains "(action) Choose a type of Action. Opponents cannot take that Action until your next turn. You may not choose the same type of Action more than once this game." After you Play this card on Fateweaver, Timeweaver, or Spaceweaver, it may Use this Ability.

cards.name: Doom Bolt
cards.text: Attach to a friendly fighter. This fighter gains "(action) Destroy this fighter and all adjacent fighters that share a trait with it." Once per turn, after attached Shadow Moves or is relocated, it may Use this Ability.
